continuity_assumptions.assumption_description: state changes gradually over modeled time
continuity_assumptions.review_question: Are shocks, events, or thresholds possible?
continuity_assumptions.warning: Smooth output does not prove smooth system behavior.

continuity_assumptions.assumption_description: rate can be represented as a continuous function

continuity_assumptions.assumption_description: aggregate variable represents the system adequately
